Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH package?
The
Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH
is an advanced full body health checkup in Thyrocares popular Aarogyam series, positioned one tier above the Aarogyam C Pro. It evaluates 78+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering all the standard organ-system screening (heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, CBC, vitamins, iron) plus additional cardiac risk markers like HsCRP, complete iron studies and select metabolic parameters that the C Pro does not include. The thyroid panel uses Ultra-Sensitive TSH (UTSH) for maximum precision. Processed at near by Thyrocares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable with free pan-India home sample collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. How is the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro different from Aarogyam C Pro?
The key difference is depth, particularly in cardiac risk assessment. While the Aarogyam C Pro covers 70+ parameters with Ultra-Sensitive TSH, the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro expands this to 78+ parameters by adding HsCRP (High-sensitivity C-Reactive Protein for cardiac inflammation), a complete iron studies profile (typically including TIBC, transferrin saturation, ferritin) and additional metabolic markers. Both packages share the Ultra-Sensitive TSH thyroid evaluation. The Aarogyam D Pro is the better choice when you want deeper cardiac and metabolic screening while keeping the same thyroid precision.
3. Why is HsCRP and cardiac risk testing important for Indian adults?
HsCRP (High-sensitivity C-Reactive Protein) measures low-grade systemic inflammation that is now recognised as a major independent predictor of cardiovascular disease, often catching heart disease risk that a standard lipid profile alone misses. Indian adults develop coronary artery disease an estimated 8 to 10 years earlier than Western populations, driven by genetic predisposition, abdominal obesity, dietary patterns and high diabetes prevalence. The Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH includes HsCRP precisely because it gives a more complete cardiac risk picture than cholesterol values alone — which is critical for the Indian population.
4. What additional parameters does the Aarogyam D Pro include over C Pro?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro typically adds HsCRP (cardiac inflammation marker), Total Iron Binding Capacity (TIBC), Transferrin Saturation, Ferritin (the full iron profile rather than just iron value), and select additional metabolic and electrolyte parameters. The exact additional parameters are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking confirmation. The Ultra-Sensitive TSH thyroid panel remains the same as in the Aarogyam C Pro, ensuring consistent thyroid evaluation quality across the Pro tier.
5. Who should choose the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro over the C Pro?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro is best suited for Indian adults aged 35 and above; people with a family history of heart disease, diabetes or hypertension; men over 30 in sedentary jobs with abdominal obesity; women over 40, especially those approaching or post-menopause when cardiovascular risk rises; people with elevated cholesterol or borderline lipid profiles from previous reports; individuals with suspected or known iron deficiency wanting deeper iron studies; and anyone wanting an annual baseline that closely matches an executive health check at a substantially lower cost.
6. What does the 78+ parameter list in the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro cover?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH typically covers Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Complete Blood Count (CBC), HbA1c and Fasting Glucose (diabetes), Ultra-Sensitive TSH plus T3 and T4 (thyroid), Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Complete Iron Studies (Iron, Ferritin, TIBC, Transferrin Saturation), HsCRP (cardiac inflammation), Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride), Calcium and complete Urine Routine. The full parameter breakdown and a sample Aarogyam report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in.
7. Is the Aarogyam D Pro suitable for people with a family history of heart disease?
Yes, and it is one of the strongest reasons to choose the
Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro
over the basic Aarogyam tiers. Family history of premature coronary artery disease (heart attack before age 55 in male relatives or 65 in female relatives) significantly raises your personal lifetime risk, often before lifestyle factors take effect. The HsCRP marker in the Aarogyam D Pro adds a layer of cardiac risk evaluation that catches inflammation-driven atherosclerotic risk not visible in a standard cholesterol panel. Annual screening with this Thyrocare package is widely recommended for adults with such family history.
8. How does the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro compare to a typical executive health checkup?
A typical hospital-based executive health checkup in India covers 60 to 80 parameters with consultation, priced significantly higher due to facility, doctor and overhead costs. The Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH delivers a comparable 78+ parameters with the upgraded Ultra-Sensitive TSH and cardiac risk markers — a similar or wider scope at a substantially lower price point. Combined with free home sample collection, digital reports in 24 hours, the Aarogyam D Pro offers strong clinical value for adults wanting an executive-tier checkup without the hospital price.
9. Is Ultra-Sensitive TSH (UTSH) still included in the Aarogyam D Pro package?
Yes. The Ultra-Sensitive TSH is a defining feature of the Pro tier in Thyrocares Aarogyam series and is retained in both the Aarogyam C Pro and Aarogyam D Pro. The UTSH detects values as low as 0.01 mIU/L, ten times more sensitive than standard TSH — allowing detection of subclinical thyroid disorders, monitoring of thyroid cancer survivors on suppression therapy, and precise titration of thyroid medication. Choosing the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro over the C Pro means you get the cardiac and metabolic upgrades without losing any of the thyroid precision.
10. How do I book the Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH for home collection in India?
Booking is a simple three-step process on bookmytest.co.in — select the
Thyrocare Aarogyam D Pro with UTSH
package, enter your address and preferred 2-hour home collection slot (ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting), and confirm with online payment. A trained Thyrocare phlebotomist arrives at your home for sample collection. The sample is sent to near by Thyrocares NABL-accredited laboratory for processing, and digital reports are delivered to email and WhatsApp within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH package?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH is a premium full body health checkup in the popular Aarogyam series, enhanced with Ultra-Sensitive Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (UTSH) testing. It evaluates 70+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering heart (lipid profile), liver (LFT), kidney (KFT), diabetes (HbA1c, fasting glucose), thyroid (Ultra-Sensitive TSH, T3, T4), complete blood count, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, iron studies and electrolytes. Processed at Near by Thyrocares NABL-accredited laboratory, the package is bookable online with free pan-India home sample collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. What is UTSH (Ultra-Sensitive TSH) and how is it different from standard TSH?
UTSH stands for Ultra-Sensitive TSH — a more precise version of the standard Thyroid Stimulating Hormone test. Standard TSH testing typically detects values down to about 0.1 mIU/L, while Ultra-Sensitive TSH used in the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro detects values as low as 0.01 mIU/L. This 10-times-greater sensitivity is clinically important for diagnosing subclinical hyperthyroidism, monitoring thyroid cancer survivors on suppression therapy, fine-tuning thyroid medication dosage, and detecting subtle pituitary disorders that standard TSH may miss.
3. How is the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro different from regular Aarogyam C?
The "Pro" upgrade in the Aarogyam C Pro represents an enhanced testing tier within Thyrocares Aarogyam series. While the standard Aarogyam C covers approximately 70 parameters with standard TSH testing, the Aarogyam C Pro retains the comprehensive parameter coverage but upgrades the thyroid assessment to Ultra-Sensitive TSH (UTSH). For users who care specifically about thyroid precision — those with known thyroid history, family history of thyroid disease, persistent thyroid-like symptoms, or simply wanting the most accurate annual screening — the
Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH
is the better choice.
4. Who should choose the Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH over other Aarogyam tiers?
The
Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH
is particularly suited for Indian women aged 30+ given Indias high female hypothyroidism prevalence; men and women with a family history of thyroid disorder, autoimmune disease or diabetes; people experiencing persistent unexplained fatigue, weight changes, hair fall, irregular periods or mood changes despite normal standard thyroid tests; thyroid cancer survivors on thyroxine suppression therapy; and anyone wanting the most thyroid-precise annual full body checkup available. For first-time testers without thyroid concerns, the regular
Aarogyam 1.3 or Aarogyam B may be sufficient.
5. What does the 70+ parameter list in the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro cover?
The
Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH
typically covers Lipid Profile (heart), Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Complete Blood Count (CBC), HbA1c and Fasting Glucose (diabetes), Ultra-Sensitive TSH plus T3 and T4 (thyroid), Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride), Calcium, and complete Urine Routine examination. The exact parameter list, is visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking confirmation.
6. Is fasting required for the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required for accurate results. Fasting is essential for lipid profile, fasting blood glucose and insulin readings — all affected by recent food intake. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue prescription medication, including thyroid medication, unless your doctor specifies otherwise. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours and heavy exercise for 12 hours before the Thyrocare phlebotomist visit. Morning collection between 6 AM and 10 AM is ideal because thyroid hormones follow a daily rhythm and are most accurately measured early in the day.
7. Why is Ultra-Sensitive TSH particularly important for Indian women?
Indian women have one of the highest rates of hypothyroidism in the world — research suggests over 11% of Indian women have some form of thyroid disorder, often subclinical and silent. Standard TSH testing can sometimes miss the borderline range where many Indian women actually sit. The Ultra-Sensitive TSH in the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro detects these subtle imbalances more reliably, which is particularly important during pregnancy (where even mild thyroid disturbance affects foetal development), perimenopause, post-pregnancy thyroiditis and PCOD-thyroid overlap cases. Annual screening with this package is widely recommended by Indian endocrinologists.
8. How does the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro report compare to a hospital health checkup?
A typical hospital-based annual health checkup in India covers 40 to 60 parameters with standard TSH testing, priced significantly higher due to facility and consultation overheads. The
Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH
delivers 70+ parameters with the upgraded Ultra-Sensitive TSH — a wider and more precise scope at a substantially lower price point. Combined with free home sample collection, digital reports in 24 hours.
9. How often should I repeat the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH?
Annually for most adults aged 25 and above as part of preventive screening. Every 6 months for people managing chronic conditions like hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, diabetes, hypertension or PCOD, where tracking trends matters more than single-point readings. Every 3 months during active thyroid medication titration, particularly when adjusting thyroxine doses or transitioning between medications. Annual repeat testing through the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro builds a year-on-year trend line that catches early drift in TSH, HbA1c, lipid profile or Vitamin D long before clinical disease develops.
10. How do I book the Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH for home collection in India?
Booking is a simple three-step process on bookmytest.co.in — select the
Thyrocare Aarogyam C Pro with UTSH

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro with UTSH package?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro with UTSH package includes approximately 68 essential health parameters. It covers ultra-sensitive TSH, thyroid hormones (T3, T4), lipid profile, liver function tests (LFT), kidney function tests (KFT), fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, complete blood count (CBC), iron studies, electrolytes (sodium, chloride).
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro with UTSH package?
This advanced health screening is suitable for individuals seeking a detailed and comprehensive preventive health assessment. It is highly recommended for people with a family history of thyroid disorders, diabetes, heart disease, or nutritional deficiencies. It is also ideal for annual health check-ups for working professionals or aging adults.
3. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro test?
Yes. A fasting period of 10 to 12 hours is necessary before sample collection. Only water should be consumed during this period. Fasting ensures accurate results, especially for blood glucose, lipid levels, and liver enzyme markers.
4. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro with UTSH?
Thyrocare offers home sample collection through trained and certified phlebotomists. The blood and urine samples are collected at your doorstep in a hygienic manner and sent to Thyrocare’s fully automated and NABL-certified laboratories for analysis.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro with UTSH package?
The package is affordably priced at Rs 1,499. It offers great value with over 68 tests included and free home collection, making it one of the most comprehensive preventive health packages by Thyrocare.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare reports?
Test reports are generally delivered within 24 to 48 hours after the sample collection. Thyrocare provides secure digital reports via email or mobile platforms for easy access and review.
7. Is this package available across India through Thyrocare?
Yes. Thyrocare offers this package across most cities and towns in India. The home sample collection service ensures that customers can get tested conveniently from their home, no matter their location.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Aarogyam B Pro with UTSH package unique?
This package stands out due to its wide diagnostic coverage, including thyroid, cardiac, liver, kidney, vitamin, sugar, and inflammation markers. With ultra-sensitive TSH and other high-value parameters tested under one roof, and results processed in Thyrocare’s fully automated labs, this profile provides a complete picture of your health.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH includes approximately 97 vital health parameters. It offers a complete diagnostic overview including ultra-sensitive TSH, thyroid hormones (T3, T4), lipid profile, liver function tests (LFT),blood sugar tests (fasting, post-prandial, HbA1c), complete blood count (CBC), iron studies, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, urine analysis and essential mineral profiles.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH?
This package is best suited for corporate professionals, executives, and individuals seeking a thorough full-body preventive health check-up. It’s especially beneficial for those with lifestyle-related risk factors such as stress, sedentary habits, or a family history of thyroid disorders, heart disease, diabetes, or nutritional deficiencies.
3. Is fasting required before the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp test?
Yes, fasting for 10 to 12 hours is required. During this time, only water is allowed. Fasting helps ensure accurate readings for glucose, cholesterol, liver enzymes, and other metabolic indicators.
4. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH?
Thyrocare provides convenient home sample collection. A trained and certified phlebotomist visits your location to collect the necessary blood and urine samples, which are then processed in Thyrocare’s NABL-accredited and fully automated diagnostic laboratories.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH?
This premium diagnostic package is generally priced at Rs 1,799. It includes over 97 tests and free home sample collection, making it a high-value health screening option for preventive care.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare reports?
Digital reports are usually delivered within 24 to 48 hours after the sample is collected. Thyrocare ensures quick access through email or mobile platforms, allowing you to easily review and consult your healthcare provider.
7. Is the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH available across India?
Yes, this package is available nationwide. Thyrocare has a widespread network for home sample collection, covering most urban and semi-urban regions across India.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Aarogyam Corp Package with UTSH unique?
This package offers a complete health evaluation tailored for working individuals. It combines comprehensive diagnostic testing—including thyroid, cardiac, liver, kidney, sugar, vitamin, and hormone profiles—processed with precision at Thyrocare’s state-of-the-art laboratories. It’s designed for early detection, lifestyle management, and preventive health monitoring.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Frequently Asked Questions – Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH
1. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH package?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH package includes around 90 essential health parameters. It covers ultra-sensitive TSH, thyroid hormones (T3, T4), complete blood count (CBC), fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, liver function tests (LFT), iron profile, electrolytes, cardiac markers, vitamins (Vitamin D, B12), inflammatory and arthritis markers, and more.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH package?
This package is suitable for individuals seeking a comprehensive preventive health check-up. It is especially recommended for those monitoring thyroid health, kidney function, lung performance, cardiac wellness, early arthritis signs, and nutritional status.
3. Is fasting required before taking this Thyrocare test?
Yes, fasting for 10 to 12 hours is required before sample collection. Only water should be consumed during this period. Fasting ensures the accuracy of glucose, lipid, and enzyme-related test results.
4. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH?
Thyrocare provides convenient home sample collection by trained and certified phlebotomists. Blood and urine samples are collected safely at your doorstep and processed at Thyrocare’s NABL-accredited, fully automated diagnostic laboratories.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH package?
This full-body health screening package is typically priced at Rs 3,399. It includes a wide range of advanced diagnostic tests along with free home sample collection, offering strong value for preventive care.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare test reports?
Test reports are usually delivered within 24 to 48 hours after sample collection. Thyrocare ensures fast and secure digital delivery of your reports via email or mobile access.
7. Is this Thyrocare package available across India?
Yes, the Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH is available nationwide. Thyrocare’s extensive logistics and phlebotomy network allows sample collection from most metro cities, tier-2 towns, and even semi-urban areas.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Aarogyam E Pro with UTSH package unique?
This package offers an advanced preventive health assessment by including specialized markers like Cystatin C for kidney function and Alpha-1 Antitrypsin for lung health. Coupled with comprehensive thyroid, vitamin, metabolic, and inflammation profiles, it gives you a well-rounded view of your health — all backed by Thyrocare’s fully automated, high-precision laboratories.

The Thyrocare Aarogyam F Pro with UTSH package includes around 114 essential health parameters. It offers comprehensive testing of ultra-sensitive TSH, thyroid hormones (T3, T4), liver function tests, diabetes profile (fasting glucose, HbA1c), complete blood count (CBC), iron profile, electrolytes, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, uric acid, high-sensitivity CRP, cardiac risk markers, hormone panel and essential minerals.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Aarogyam F Pro with UTSH package?
This package is designed for individuals who need an extensive full-body preventive health check-up. It is especially suitable for those with multiple health concerns such as thyroid imbalance, diabetes, heart-related risks, hormonal fluctuations, and vitamin/mineral deficiencies. It is also ideal for people opting for annual health evaluations.
3. Is fasting required before taking this Thyrocare test?
Yes, a fasting period of 10 to 12 hours is recommended before sample collection. Only water should be consumed during this time. Fasting ensures more accurate results, particularly for blood sugar, lipid, and metabolic tests.

Thyrocare offers free home sample collection by trained phlebotomists. Blood and urine samples are collected safely at your location and tested at Thyrocare’s NABL-accredited, fully automated diagnostic laboratories.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Aarogyam F Pro with UTSH package?
This in-depth health package is priced at Rs 4,399. It covers over 114 parameters with complimentary home collection, delivering excellent value for a comprehensive health assessment.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare test reports?
Test reports are typically delivered within 24 to 48 hours after the sample is collected. Thyrocare ensures timely digital report delivery through email or mobile access for fast and easy consultation.
7. Is the Thyrocare Aarogyam F Pro with UTSH package available across India?
Yes, Thyrocare offers nationwide availability of this package. With a wide phlebotomy and logistics network, sample collection is accessible in most major cities, towns, and even semi-urban areas.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Aarogyam F Pro with UTSH unique?
This package offers one of the most detailed health check-ups available. It combines advanced thyroid analysis with a full panel covering heart health, liver function, hormones, essential nutrients, toxic elements, and inflammation markers. All testing is performed in Thyrocare’s fully automated labs, ensuring accurate and reliable diagnostic outcomes.

The Thyrocare Aarogyam X Plus Profile with UTSH includes an extensive panel of around
153 health tests
. This comprehensive check-up covers ultra-sensitive TSH, thyroid hormones (T3, T4), complete blood count (CBC), liver function tests, fasting and HbA1c, lipid profile, iron studies, electrolytes, uric acid, calcium, cardiac risk markers (hs-CRP, Apo A1/Apo B, Homocysteine, Lipoprotein A), hormone panel, arthritis markers, pancreatic enzymes, and toxic element screening.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Aarogyam X Plus Profile with UTSH package?
This advanced diagnostic package is ideal for individuals aged 30 and above, those with lifestyle-related risk factors, or individuals with a family history of chronic health issues. It is especially beneficial for people looking for a
comprehensive preventive health screening
covering multiple organ systems, hormones, and risk factors.
3. Is fasting required before taking this Thyrocare test?
Yes, fasting for
10 to 12 hours
is required prior to sample collection. During this period, only water may be consumed. Fasting ensures accurate results for blood sugar, cholesterol, and metabolic tests.

Thyrocare offers
home sample collection
by trained phlebotomists. The collection is safe, hygienic, and convenient. All samples are analyzed at Thyrocare’s
NABL-accredited and fully automated laboratories
, ensuring reliability and precision.

5,499
, including over 150+ tests and free doorstep sample collection. It is an excellent choice for those seeking a full-body health check-up with detailed insights.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare test reports?
Test reports are usually delivered within
24 to 48 hours
after sample collection. Thyrocare ensures timely and secure digital report delivery via email or mobile app access.
7. Is the Thyrocare Aarogyam X Plus Profile with UTSH package available across India?
Yes, this package is available
pan India
. Thyrocare’s strong logistical network supports home sample collection and lab processing in most major cities and towns across the country.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Aarogyam X Plus Profile with UTSH unique?
This is one of Thyrocare’s most
comprehensive preventive health packages
. It evaluates hormonal balance, organ function, cardiovascular risk, nutritional deficiencies, and exposure to toxic elements—all in a single profile. Backed by Thyrocare’s advanced automation and quality assurance, it delivers reliable and actionable health insights.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. Why should I consider the Thyrocare AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package during the monsoon season?
The monsoon season can affect daily routines, food habits and physical activity, while symptoms such as tiredness or weakness may be overlooked as seasonal. The AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package provides a convenient way to assess multiple important health markers together and identify abnormalities that may otherwise go unnoticed.
2. Is the AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package only for people who are unwell?
No. The package is primarily useful for preventive health screening and can also be taken by people who do not have any symptoms. Regular blood testing can help identify changes in important health parameters before noticeable health problems develop.
3. What type of health information can I get from this Thyrocare package?
The package provides information across multiple areas of health. Depending on the current test composition, it can help assess parameters related to blood health, metabolism, blood sugar, cholesterol, thyroid function, nutritional status and vital organ health. Always check the displayed test list for the exact parameters included.
4. Can the AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package help identify the reason for tiredness and weakness?
The package may identify abnormalities such as anaemia, nutritional deficiencies, thyroid-related changes or blood sugar abnormalities that can sometimes be associated with fatigue and weakness. However, tiredness can have many causes, so persistent symptoms should be discussed with a doctor.
5. Is the Thyrocare AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package suitable for an annual health checkup?
It can be a useful option for routine preventive screening. The ideal tests and frequency of health checkups vary according to your age, lifestyle, family history, existing medical conditions and previous test results.
6. Do I need to fast before taking the AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package?
Fasting may be required for accurate measurement of certain parameters included in a comprehensive health package. Follow the specific fasting instructions mentioned with your booking. If fasting is advised, plain water is generally permitted unless instructed otherwise.
7. What should I do if one or more results are outside the normal range?
A value outside the laboratory reference range does not automatically mean you have a disease. Results can vary because of age, diet, medications, lifestyle and other factors. A doctor can interpret abnormal values together with your symptoms and medical history and advise whether further investigation is necessary.
8. Can I book the Thyrocare AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package with home sample collection?
Home sample collection is available at eligible serviceable locations. This allows you to book the
Thyrocare AAROGYAM Monsoon Basic Package online
and have the required samples collected conveniently from your home.

What is the B-cell (CD19) Blood Test?
The B-cell (CD19) Blood Test is a diagnostic test that measures the number of B-cells in the blood to assess immune system function.
Who should opt for this test?
This test is recommended for individuals with suspected immune disorders, autoimmune diseases, unexplained infections or conditions affecting lymphocytes.
What does the B-cell (CD19) Blood Test detect?
It helps detect abnormalities in B-cell levels, which may be associated with autoimmune conditions, lymphomas and immunodeficiency disorders.
Why is this test important?
This test helps in evaluating immune system health, diagnosing disorders and guiding treatment planning.
Is fasting required for this test?
Fasting is generally not required, but specific instructions may be provided at the time of booking.
How is the sample collected?

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the Total Health Profile Plus?
The Total Health Profile Plus is a full body health screening package designed to assess overall health including thyroid function, diabetes, heart risk and urinary health.
Who should opt for the Total Health Profile Plus?
This package is suitable for individuals looking for a comprehensive routine health checkup, working professionals and anyone who wants early detection of potential health issues.
What does the Total Health Profile Plus include?
It includes Thyroid profile, Diabetes screening, Cardiac risk markers, Complete Urine Analysis and other essential tests for a complete health overview.
Why is this package important?
This package helps detect early signs of diabetes, heart risk, thyroid imbalance and other underlying health conditions, enabling timely medical advice and preventive care.
Is fasting required for this package?
Fasting may be required for certain tests such as blood sugar and lipid profile to ensure accurate results.
How is the sample collected?
Samples are collected through home sample collection by trained technicians, ensuring a safe and convenient testing experience.
